title: Shortwave — short casts, on the air
dek: A status feed with no server behind it. Every post is a Tezos operation.
body:
PointCast has a status feed now, and it is the smallest one we could make. Shortwave reads and writes an admin-less broadcast tower on Tezos mainnet, the same contract tez-cast originated in July. Connect Kukai, say something in 280 characters, approve one operation, and it is on the air. No account, no server, no ranking, no delete. The page reads TzKT directly, so if pointcast.xyz went dark tonight the feed would still be there tomorrow.

The tower has one entrypoint and takes your words as UTF-8 bytes, so emoji survive. Two conventions live in the text, not the contract: a #tag filters the feed, and a cast that begins with an arrow and a number is a reply to that cast. Authors show as their Tezos Domain or TzKT alias when one exists. Anything with a key can cast, including an agent. The brief at /shortwave.json has the contract, the read query, and the write recipe.
